sys_pd_process_definition.description: A playbook for product development, starting from conceptualization, market research, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, and launch.
sys_pd_process_definition.label: product dev process
sys_pd_process_definition.name: product_dev_process
sys_pd_process_definition.now_assist_prompt: Create a playbook for product development. It begins with conceptualizing the product, refining its concept, and conducting market research. Simultaneously, design and engineering teams work on prototyping while marketing prepares promotional strategies. Once the prototype nears completion, testing begins alongside finalizing marketing materials. Feedback from testing informs iterative design changes. Upon successful testing, manufacturing commences while marketing focuses on promotional efforts. Finally, the product is launched, and post-launch monitoring kicks off to assess customer feedback and make further improvements as needed.
